Plot variance and cross-covariance components from genuine functional mixed-effects likelihood

etr_plot_functional_variance_decomposition.Rd

Direct native R nlme spline-Gaussian covariance components are used without refitting, source identity substitution or automatically selecting models. A sensitivity model must be explicitly named; failed models have no variance decomposition. This scientific geometry review excludes independent Python statsmodels optimizer and Matplotlib object/pixel identity.

Usage

etr_plot_functional_variance_decomposition(
    result, ..., model = NULL, strict_source_record = FALSE)

Arguments

result

Existing restricted R moment estimator for legacy default plotting, or a genuine native fitted Gaussian joint B-spline likelihood model or W3 sensitivity scientific record in strict mode.

...

Native base R plotting arguments retained for the legacy moments renderer.

model

Named converged sensitivity model to plot in strict mode, required for sensitivity result and prohibited for a direct fitted likelihood model.

strict_source_record

Draw real native Gaussian variance components and return source-ordered Matplotlib scientific line, reference and axes geometry as a native R record.

Value

In default mode, native source time/component frame. In strict mode, a typed source-scientific one-panel plot record containing the actual fitted participant/trial/residual covariance component curves, zero line and declared model label.
